payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear comparison between crowd evaluations and expert evaluations of lexicons, highlighting the advantages of crowdsourcing in lexicon acquisition.

claims.text: Crowd evaluations of lexicons are compared to those of expert linguists to assess quality.
Crowdsourced lexicons are more scalable and cost-effective compared to those created by experts.
The diversity of crowd contributors replaces the uniformity of expert judgment in lexicon evaluation.
The proposed method aims to automate the lexicon creation and evaluation process using crowdsourcing.
